title: Algebra Vocabulary
description: Match each word with its meaning.

pairs.a: A letter that stands for an unknown number
The number multiplied by a variable, like the 4 in $4x$
A term with no variable, whose value never changes
Terms with the same variables raised to the same powers
Numbers, variables and operations with *no* equals sign
A statement that two expressions are equal
A value that makes an equation true
Operations that undo each other, like adding and subtracting
One part of an expression, separated from the others by $+$ or $-$
How many times a base is used as a factor
